gloss: coexistence; standing side by side; juxtaposition

definitions.gloss: coexistence; standing side by side; juxtaposition; being on equal footing
definitions.explanation: The state of two or more things existing or standing alongside each other on equal terms, without one dominating the other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{並立|へいりつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Two opinions coexist side by side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{革新|かくしん}→革新：05617_kakushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{並立|へいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The coexistence of tradition and innovation is being sought.

examples.japanese: ⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{並立|へいりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{合意形成|ごういけいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: Under a political system where multiple parties coexist, reaching consensus takes time.

notes:
Describes the state of two or more things existing or standing alongside each other on equal footing. Combines {並|へい} (lined up, side by side) and {立|りつ} (stand).

USAGE:
- Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {並立|へいりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to coexist, to stand side by side)
- Often used for abstract concepts that exist simultaneously: opinions, systems, values
- Also used as a grammatical term: {並立|へいりつ}⟦{助詞|じょし}→助詞：03351_joshi⟧ (coordinating particle, e.g., ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧, や)
- Implies that the coexisting items are on equal terms, not that one dominates

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {並立|へいりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to coexist, to stand together
- {並立|へいりつ}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: parallel relationship
- {並立|へいりつ}⟦{助詞|じょし}→助詞：03351_joshi⟧: coordinating particle (grammar term)
- {並立|へいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: difficult to have side by side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{共存|きょうぞん}→共存：11675_kyouzon⟧: coexistence — emphasizes living together harmoniously
- ⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧: compatibility, achieving both — emphasizes making two things work at the same time
- {併存|へいぞん}: coexistence — very similar, but more formal and used for systems or conditions
